code_style: AI-code. AI-generated attributed leading-meson union model.
physics_scope: Exclusive primary non-diffractive pp light-meson electromagnetic benchmarks: eta/eta-prime photon and coherent charged-dipion transitions, and rho/omega/phi/Kstar radiative transitions including charge conjugates. Native parent sources use explicit zero-width pole masses, with unpolarized vector parents. Measured rates and published transition models carry recorded tensions and missing uncertainties. Not an inclusive validated meson-production or limit model. The neutral-rho charged-dipion radiation channel uses the conserved minimal scalar-QED current, including its contact term, normalized to the approximately unity rho-to-dipion branching fraction. Extra structure-dependent radiation is not included. Charged rho± -> pi± pi0 A-prime is added as an explicit local g_EM=2 charged-vector benchmark, with coherent parent radiation, charged-pion radiation and contact term. Its published full-model photon comparison has an unresolved 11.6 percent rate discrepancy; no physical uncertainty is inferred from that comparison. Adds nine qualified KL/KS/charged-kaon radiative and weak-current numerical benchmarks and coherent rho0/omega->pi0 pi0 A-prime leading currents. This finite 30-channel union is not proof of all-meson completeness. Natural kaon flight, material transport and fixed detector constraints require the separate full-chain gate. Unknown timelike hadronic operators, source-spectrum uncertainties and listed residual families remain explicit.
radiative_branching_formula: 2 * epsilon^2 * BR(P -> gamma gamma) * (1 - mass^2 / parent_mass^2)^3 * abs(F(mass^2)/F(0))^2
radiative_branching_reference_note: Eq. 6 is pointlike; multiplying by the measured transition form factor follows the electromagnetic transition amplitude in Eqs. 1-5.

crosschecks.note: The real-photon rate and differential spectrum are independent cross-checks. The fitted effective rho mass is uncertain, and no covariance is available. Photon-normalized prediction for the measured ee mode differs by about 10 percent. Record this discrepancy; normalization to the measured ee mode is not independent rate validation.

Gamma-normalized predictions for ee and mu-mu are about 10 percent below the measured Dalitz rates. Using the measured mu-mu mode fixes one overall amplitude; it does not independently validate the real-photon prediction. Published fit covariance and numerical differential data were not available in the inspected article.

normalization.note: PDG quotes approximately 100 percent; unity is the explicit dominant-mode approximation, with no invented measurement error.

rho_radiative_model.assumption: Minimal gauged derivative rho-pion coupling: both charged-pion radiation diagrams plus the contact term. Extra transverse structure-dependent currents are set to zero in this exploratory benchmark.

photon_validation.note: Independent real-photon rate check, not a fit or a massive-signal uncertainty estimate.

rho_radiative_model.numerical_mass_tolerance_note: The strict default pole comparison uses the declared 1e-6 GeV numerical band. A separately explicit native-Pythia context preserves the original four-vector and native zero-width pole probability, requires unchanged Check:mTolErr and open-channel agreement, and limits the diagnostic rate change to 0.1 percent. Outside the interpolation band the diagnostic uses exact quadrature; this is not physical off-shell rho support.

theoretical_limitations: Minimal gauging fixes both loop tensors within this Lagrangian. It does not determine additional higher-derivative local timelike operators or hadronic form factors.

The selected linear-sigma rescattering scenario replaces the chiral term; adding an independent sigma amplitude would double count it. Zero scalar flavor mixing and a constant sigma width are explicit benchmark assumptions.
Kaon rescattering uses its leading chiral term. Flavor breaking, scalar kaon rescattering, empirical FV minus 2GV contact structures and higher chiral orders are not covered by the scalar scenarios.
Photon measurements test normalization and interference at q2=0. They do not bound virtual-only currents.

Natural rho/omega ancestors in the collision source are included in the parent inventory. Future exclusive replacement needs a source/ancestry audit and coherent sibling handling before any admission.
No detector, trigger, material, dimuon branching, production uncertainty or acceptance claim follows from this rate kernel.

form_factor_uncertainty.prescription: Store central values and individual parameter shifts; a box envelope with statistical and systematic errors combined in quadrature is a diagnostic, not a joint confidence interval.

width_authority.muon_mass_note: The pinned provider threshold is 3.249 keV above the decay-kernel threshold. The initial grid starts at 0.22 GeV; sub-keV threshold scans require a recorded consistent mass override.
width_authority.hadronic_width: Pinned data-driven electromagnetic exclusive spectral channels, including low-mass hadrons and resonances; do not replace with free-quark R or add another running-alpha factor.

source.cross_section_model: Pythia 8.317 energy-dependent SaS/Donnachie-Landshoff non-diffractive pp; CP5 hadronization/MPI settings retained
source.cross_section_note: Explicit mode 1 replaces the CP5 mode 0 fixed LHC total/elastic rates. ND-only generator prediction at the actual fixed-target energy; parent spectra and absolute normalization are provisional, not a data calibration.
source.unit_weight_signal_proposal: Accept one full collision proportional to the sum of all physical parent/channel coefficients, then select exactly one parent and exclusive channel from that same sum. Natural-source parent inventory is never repeated for additional channels.
source.double_counting_rule: Keep DY and this meson mechanism distinct. Sum different physical mechanisms with their own rates; never average their generator cross sections.
source.vector_source_prescription: Set each declared vector parent mass and mass-selection bounds to its referenced pole before generation, with mWidth=0. The same narrow prescription is explicit for the dipion eta parents. Never repair an existing parent four-vector or discard off-shell source collisions.
source.vector_source_precision: Narrow-width approximation only. Compare rates/spectra with a separately qualified finite-width prescription before claiming complete meson physics, especially near endpoints.
source.spin_precision: Vector-parent isotropy assumes no spin alignment. This is not measured for SHIFT and must remain an uncertainty/validation gap.
source.dipion_prescription: Coherent conserved magnetic current with contact, rho and eta-prime rho-omega interference; retain the pion/muon-plane correlation. Normalize each parent amplitude once to its measured Dalitz branching fraction; real-photon rates are independent cross-checks and retain their recorded tensions.
source.neutral_dipion_prescription: One coherent loop/scalar/VMD amplitude with both massive transverse tensors, identical-pi0 symmetry factor and full correlated dimuon polarization. Source coefficient and unit-weight sampling share the exact positive bilinear numerical CDF integral; epsilon, lifetime, source event weights and parent momenta remain unchanged.

initial_grid.lab_to_ctau: Use the original eta/eta-prime reference-grid physical epsilon and proper lifetime when comparing or combining mechanisms. A common LAB directory label is a declared reference, not the actual equal mean flight of all mechanisms.
initial_grid.validity_note: New narrow-source light-meson channels open only below their own physical recoil threshold; each form factor retains its declared mass domain. At .9 GeV only eta-prime -> gamma Aprime is open in this pole-source benchmark. Broad vector tails are a separate unresolved source-model gap.

omitted_mechanisms: other multiparticle and excited-meson electromagnetic transitions
Other weak kaon amplitudes and heavy-flavour decays; finite relevance notes are in SHIFT_BSM.md
vector_branching_formula: epsilon^2 * BR(V -> P gamma) * abs(F(mass^2)/F(0))^2 * [pstar(mass)/pstar(0)]^3; no identical-photon factor two
completion_policy: Keep physics_complete false until every relevant channel has a validated rate and differential source model or a quantitative omitted-yield bound at each mass/lifetime. Photon branching fractions and a short parent-counting probe are not such bounds.
radiative_branching_formula_scope: Pseudoscalar -> photon Aprime only; vector and dipion channels use their separately declared kernels and normalization authorities.
finite_scope_note: The 588 real-photon decay inventory did not cover virtual-only weak currents. The source census and finite leading-family audit do not establish universal physics completeness.
